# HAPI v0.29.0.5 (maintained build)

Upstream-first rebuild from `tiann/hapi` `upstream/main` at `980a921ba15665c54998a6ddb658103d467ff4cb`, with the audited self-maintained overlay and the complete exact head of `#1741`.

## Compared with the previous maintained release

Compared with `v0.29.0.4`, this release:

- Carries all seven commits from `#1741` at exact head `c22780ba5588340ff2813f9e139f2abaa35f7e65`.
- Uses stable, non-blank stream IDs for streamed reasoning and text block identity in Web, iOS, and Android, preventing the first live Pi reasoning block from being repeatedly remounted and flashing.
- Adds `HAPI_TITLE_PROVIDER_MAX_TOKENS` and `HAPI_TITLE_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT_MS` for reasoning-model title providers while retaining the maintained settings-file timeout and safe provider-error behavior.
- Defers new draft `#1762`; every other open upstream PR head and mechanical status is unchanged from the prior audit.

## Compared with the official release

Compared with official `v0.29.0`, this build contains the maintained desktop, fleet, import, jobs, model-error, scratchlist, schema V29, protocol v2, and audited open-PR behavior already shipped in `v0.29.0.4`, plus the updates listed above.

Open-PR audit: 154 open PRs reviewed — 54 carry, 96 defer, 4 drop. `#1680`, `#1597`/`#1093`, and `#1091` remain dropped; `#1320` remains permanently excluded if reopened.

## Distribution

This is a standalone four-part maintained release; it is not published to npm. Its implicit standalone fleet-upgrade channel is therefore disabled, while explicit overrides remain authoritative. Optional platform packages remain pinned to official `0.29.0`.

Expected artifacts:

- CLI archives for Linux, macOS, and Windows
- Signed macOS CLI archives
- Windows and macOS desktop bundles
- `checksums.txt`
